name: Biped Locomotion Robustness Benchmark
description: A suite of tests and scenarios measuring robustness of biped locomotion controllers to disturbances, model variations, and environmental changes.
reputation: A well-cited academic benchmark for evaluating bipedal controller robustness in simulation with moderate adoption in robotics research.
notes: Non-LLM robotics benchmark focused on simulated controllers; results are sensitive to simulator settings and controller tuning and may not transfer to real hardware (sim-to-real gap).
